events.factual_description: The Atlantis presents Brazilian singer-songwriter Mari Froes on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 in Washington, DC. The venue lists doors at 6:30 PM and currently marks the show sold out; no separate stage time or face-value ticket price was verified in the current primary/authorized sources, so those are not inferred. The Atlantis describes Froes as inspired by Brazilian Popular Music and navigating Brazilian rhythms, and identifies the September-October 2026 run as her first tour in the USA and Canada. Current Sony Music information confirms that her debut album Esquina do Sol was released July 31, 2026 via RCA/Sony, correcting the venue's older pre-release copy that had projected a June release. Ticketmaster's authorized event page confirms the September 16 date, The Atlantis, Washington, DC, and a 6:30 PM event listing; because The Atlantis separately identifies 6:30 PM as doors and notes that door/set times are subject to change, RADAR leaves showtimes empty rather than treating the door time as a verified stage time.

en.why_it_matters: The hook is the crossing point: a young Brazilian voice rooted in MPB and Brazilian rhythm reaches Washington on her first North American tour just after a debut album turns that identity into a full-length statement. In a small room like The Atlantis, that makes this more than a generic tour stop and gives RADAR a useful snapshot of contemporary Brazilian music arriving in the DMV.
en.trip_verdict: If legitimate face-value access reappears and the Wednesday is open, this is worth catching locally. The tour continues through the corridor immediately afterward, so there is no reason to chase unverified resale or build a separate regional trip around the Washington sellout.

es.why_it_matters: El gancho está en el cruce: una voz brasileña joven, arraigada en la MPB y los ritmos de Brasil, llega a Washington en su primera gira norteamericana justo después de convertir esa identidad en un álbum debut de larga duración. En una sala pequeña como The Atlantis, la fecha deja de ser una parada genérica de gira y se vuelve una buena fotografía de música brasileña contemporánea entrando al DMV.
es.trip_verdict: Si reaparece acceso legítimo a precio oficial y el miércoles está libre, vale la pena aprovecharlo como plan local. La gira sigue de inmediato por el corredor, así que no perseguiría reventa sin verificar ni armaría un viaje regional separado alrededor del sold out de Washington.
